name: Michele Bachmann
summary:
Michele Marie Bachmann (; née Amble; born April 6, 1956) is an American politician who was the U.S. representative for Minnesota's 6th congressional district from 2007 until 2015. A member of the Republican Party, she was a candidate for president of the United States in the 2012 election, but dropped out after the Iowa caucuses.
Born in Waterloo, Iowa, Bachmann moved to Brooklyn Park, Minnesota as a teenager.
